balance.title: Balance
balance.description:
Net worth of your account in euros as of the quote date shown above.

It is calculated as:
Portfolio + Cash

Portfolio is the market value of open positions; Cash is the last EUR Balance from your uploaded Degiro Account Statement on or before that date (can be negative if you have a debit).

Closed-trade P/L is shown separately under Total P/L.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description:
Gross market value of all open positions, in euros.

Per position:
closing price × quantity

Converted to EUR with the USD→EUR rate for the as-of date, then summed.

Cash is not included here — see Cash and Balance.

cash.title: Cash
cash.description:
EUR cash / debit balance from your Degiro Account Statement CSV.

For the as-of date we take the last statement row with Balance currency EUR and movement date on or before that day.

Upload Account Statements from the Dashboard. Negative values mean a debit / margin balance.

day.title: Day
day.description:
This is the one-day (D‑1) change of the whole open portfolio, in euros.

Per position:
1) Take the closing price for the date shown and the previous trading day’s close (same provider).
2) Per-share change = current close − previous close.
3) Position change = per-share change × quantity.
4) Convert to EUR with today’s USD→EUR rate and sum across all positions.

Green = open book gained value that day; red = it lost value. This is not realized or lifetime P/L — only the price move between two available consecutive closes.

totalPl.title: Total P/L
totalPl.description:
This is your total accumulated profit or loss in euros, combining open and closed activity.

Total P/L = unrealized P/L (open positions) + realized P/L (fully closed trades)

Unrealized P/L (per open ISIN):
current market value − average cost of the remaining open lot
(cost is walked from buys/sells with average-cost on sells, then converted to EUR).

Realized P/L:
sum of results for ISINs whose net quantity is 0 (same basis as the Summary / trades-summary tab), using Degiro’s SUM(value) in the base currency; if that currency is USD it is converted to EUR.

Note: partial sells on a position that is still open are not counted as «realized» in Summary; their effect is absorbed into the average cost of what remains open.

Green = net accumulated profit; red = net accumulated loss.
